name: Primega Group Holdings Limited
summary: Primega Group Holdings Limited, operating through its various units, specializes in the transportation of earth and rock materials across Hong Kong. The company's diverse service portfolio also encompasses diesel fuel trading and a range of construction activities, including excavation and lateral support systems, as well as bored piling. Its primary client base consists of subcontractors involved in groundwork and site preparation for both property development and civil engineering projects. This firm was established in 2022 and maintains its principal office in San Po Kong, Hong Kong.
